recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned duo portrait set against a flat, cool pastel background, featuring bold, layered typography in the upper left quadrant. The image utilizes a limited color palette with a distinct 1960s 'technicolor' photographic quality, emphasizing saturated skin tones and high-key highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm, orange-hued subjects against a cool, pale blue background
Bold white typography anchored to the top left corner
Symmetrical placement of two figures leaning forward
High-contrast shadows in clothing versus flat, shadowless background
coreInvariants: Oversaturated, warm skin tones with orange/red undertones
Subjects leaning on a foreground element (car seat or railing)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-left typographic block serves as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large script text, moves down to the secondary text, then follows the subjects' gazes toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample flat space in the top half of the frame provides breathing room for the title and logo.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subjects contrasted with low saturation in the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of a heavy, casual script and a bold, geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Thick, rounded strokes with connected lowercase and upright posture.
Sans-serif: All-caps, heavy weight, low contrast, wide proportions.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand in the script line is stylized to match the weight of the letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for personality paired with a heavy sans-serif for structural stability.
graphicDevices: Oval logo badge in top right corner

preserve: Weight contrast between the two lines

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, casual 60s script feel.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Extra Bold or Gotham Black
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of two smiling young men with 1950s/60s hairstyles, wearing knit sweaters, leaning on a red car seat. Apply a warm, orange-tinted color grade to their skin and hair. Place them against a flat, solid pastel blue background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned white text in the top-left corner. The top line should be a heavy, rounded script. The bottom line should be a bold, wide geometric sans-serif in all caps. Add a small white oval logo in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, solid pastel blue?
Do the skin tones have a distinct warm/orange 'technicolor' cast?
Is the typography left-aligned and pure white?
Are there two distinct font styles used?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script font is thick enough to be legible against the blue.
Check that the subjects' hair has a golden/orange highlight.
Verify the red foreground element is vibrant and saturated.
Confirm the composition remains top-heavy with negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a flat pastel backdrop with a high-saturation, warm-toned portrait and anchor bold white 60s-style typography to the upper left.
